stages.name: traces
stages.claim: the data are opinion trajectories: each agent's x over time

stages.name: event
stages.claim: one event e: agent i updates from x_i^- to x_i^+, a jump delta_e = x_i^+ - x_i^-

stages.name: events
stages.claim: we observe every update but not why it happened: whom i heeded, or whether it heeded anyone
